{{short description|Spanish writer (born 1975)}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=May 2024}}

'''Paula Lapido''' is a Spanish writer born in [[Madrid]] in 1975.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.conoceralautor.com/autores/ver/NDIz|title=Video - Paula Lapido: Teoría de todo, 2010|last=|first=|date=|website=|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150610200100/http://www.conoceralautor.com/autores/ver/NDIz|archive-date=10 June 2015|access-date=}}</ref>

Her short stories collection ''Teoría del todo'' was runner up for the [[Setenil Award]] for the best short stories collection in 2010.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://portal.molinadesegura.es/images/literario/setenil/Setenil2010-04.pdf|title=Ayuntamiento de Molina de Segura – Concejalía de Cultura : Relación de títulos finalistas del VII Premio Setenil 2010|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220420001948/http://portal.molinadesegura.es/images/literario/setenil/Setenil2010-04.pdf|archive-date=20 April 2022|access-date=|url-status=dead}}</ref> Her novel ''Los que alcanzan la orilla'' was the winner in 2019 in the competition [https://www.kutxakultur.eus/es/programas/kutxa-kultur-literatura/premios-literarios-kutxa-ciudad-irun/ Kutxa Ciudad de Irun] for the best novel written in Spanish.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.kutxakultur.eus/es/2019/09/ganadores-xlii-premios-literarios-kutxa-ciudad-irun/|title=Ganadores XLIII Premios Literarios Kutxa Ciudad de Irun|last=|first=|date=|website=|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=}}</ref>

== Publications ==

* ''Teoría de todo'' (2010)
* ''Horror vacui'' (2014)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.saltodepagina.com/libro/horror-vacui/|title=Novel "Horror vacui" info in publisher's website|access-date=15 December 2019|archive-date=7 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210307024609/https://www.saltodepagina.com/libro/horror-vacui/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* ''Los que alcanzan la orilla'' (2019)<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cga.es/fichaGeneral/ficha.php?web=29&obrcod=5650021|title=Novel "Los que alcanzan la orilla" info in publisher's website}}</ref>
